kind.update: a full news item: heading, body, optional thumbnail. Needs a category.
kind.brief: a one-liner for the In brief column. Needs a tag.

category (update only).publication: a paper from the lab, once published. A preprint goes in the In brief column instead (tag: preprint) — it can still change through review.
category (update only).resource: a tool, atlas or dataset released to the community
category (update only).milestone: anything else that marks the lab's history

tag (brief only).press: mentions and interviews in news outlets, press releases
tag (brief only).preprint: a preprint posted by the lab. Add it to publications.json too, with type "preprint".
tag (brief only).note: short-form writing: editorials, commentaries, News & Views
tag (brief only).event: symposia, workshops and courses the lab organises or hosts

_memo.date: "YYYY-MM" or "YYYY". Sorted newest first; a bare year sorts below the months of that year, and same-date entries keep the order they have in this file.
_memo.html: title, body and text are written out as raw HTML, so links work and a stray < breaks the page. alt is plain text and is escaped for you.
_memo.build: python3 tools/build_news.py  — writes news.html (everything) and index.html (the latest few).

entries.title: Developmental vascular atlas published in Cell
entries.body: Our comprehensive 3D atlas of postnatal brain vascularization has been published in Cell. This work reveals a three-phase trajectory of brain vascular development, with implications for understanding neurodevelopmental disorders.
entries.alt: Vascular labelling in a postnatal mouse brain hemisphere

entries.title: Marwa Cherfaoui awarded an FRM PhD fellowship
entries.body: Congratulations to Marwa Cherfaoui, who has been awarded a PhD fellowship from the Fondation pour la Recherche Médicale (FRM) for her project on the role of brain macrophages during pregnancy.

entries.title: Gabrièle Lienhard awarded an FRM fourth-year fellowship
entries.body: Congratulations to Gabrièle Lienhard, who has received a fourth-year PhD fellowship from the Fondation pour la Recherche Médicale (FRM) to continue her work on vascular plasticity during pregnancy.

entries.title: LAMBADA atlas publicly available
entries.body: The LAMBADA Open Brain Atlas for the developing postnatal mouse brain is now freely accessible at lambada.icm-institute.org.
entries.alt: Annotated brain regions overlaid on a reconstructed vascular network

entries.title: Somatosensory feedback projections paper in iScience
entries.body: Our study on the organization and development of bilateral somatosensory feedback projections in mice has been published in iScience.
entries.alt: Projections descending from the cortical surface

entries.title: ERC Consolidator Grant awarded to the lab
entries.body: The lab has been awarded an ERC Consolidator Grant from the European Research Council to study neurovascular plasticity in the mother's brain during pregnancy.

entries.title: Maternal nesting behavior study in Neuron
entries.body: Our study identifying Edinger-Westphal peptidergic neurons as enablers of maternal preparatory nesting has been published in Neuron. This work ascribes for the first time an important ethological role to an enigmatic neuromodulatory center.

entries.title: The lab joins the Delta Tissue consortium
entries.body: The lab has joined Delta Tissue, an international consortium coordinated by Stéphane Pagès at the Wyss Center and funded by Wellcome Leap, to work on the 3D mapping of human glioblastomas.

entries.title: Brain vasculature mapping published in Cell
entries.body: Our landmark paper on mapping the fine-scale organization and plasticity of the brain vasculature has been published in Cell. The work reconstructs vascular networks spanning 300 meters with 8 million branch points.
entries.alt: Coronal view of the whole-brain vascular network

entries.title: MSCA fellowship awarded to Alba Vieites Prado
entries.body: Congratulations to Alba Vieites Prado, who has been awarded a Marie Skłodowska-Curie Actions (MSCA) fellowship to work on adult plasticity of the somatosensory cortex.

entries.title: ERC Starting Grant awarded to the lab
entries.body: The lab has been awarded an ERC Starting Grant from the European Research Council to work on postnatal brain plasticity.

entries.title: Lab founded at the Paris Brain Institute
entries.body: Nicolas Renier opens the Laboratory of Structural Plasticity at the Institut du Cerveau (ICM) in Paris, bringing tissue clearing and light-sheet microscopy expertise from Rockefeller University.

entries.text: The Paris Brain Institute's press release on the developmental atlas: How cerebral blood vessels form after birth.
Our manuscript on vascular plasticity during pregnancy is available as a pre-print on the SSRN Sneak Peek portal.
Nicolas is giving a talk in Munich at the CRC 1744: Research on Neurovascular Diseases and compartmentalized brain networks.
Our research on plasticity during pregnancy is highlighted in a symposium at FENS forum in Barcelona.
The lab is organizing and hosting the 5th iDISCO and ClearMap workshop at the Paris Brain Institute, with a first day of symposium open to everyone, on April 20th.

entries.title: FENS–EJN Young Investigator Prize awarded to Nicolas Renier
entries.body: Nicolas Renier is one of four recipients of the 2022 FENS–EJN Young Investigator Prize, awarded by the Federation of European Neuroscience Societies and the European Journal of Neuroscience, and presented at the FENS Forum.

entries.title: Cercle FSER laureate
entries.body: Nicolas Renier is a 2023 laureate of the Cercle FSER (Fondation Schlumberger pour l'Éducation et la Recherche), supporting the lab's work on the development and plasticity of the post-natal brain.

entries.text: The Institut du Cerveau's video on the developmental atlas: Comment les vaisseaux sanguins cérébraux se construisent après la naissance ? (in French).
Nicolas spoke with Stéphanie Baulac at the World Brain Health Forum, for the Paris Brain Institute's 15th anniversary: Breakthroughs in Cellular and Molecular Neurobiology.
The Institut du Cerveau on the whole-brain vascular map: La première cartographie complète de la vascularisation cérébrale, réalisée à l'ICM (in French).
Nicolas presents the lab's research programme for the Institut du Cerveau: Déchiffrer les connexions neuronales (in French).
